summary: Stops numbered 0 through n - 1 form a loop, and n is an integer from 1 to 10000. Read a travel table of length n. Entry i is the distance from stop i to stop (i + 1) modulo n, and every distance is an integer from 0 to 10000. A vehicle may run clockwise or the opposite way. Also read a departure stop and an arrival stop, both legal indexes. Write the shorter travel distance a rider needs between those two stops. The distance cap is 10000.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
